note: The Library's tag vocabulary (library/tags.js): each tag is compared with a file's pictures or sound in the embedding model's space and kept when it stands out. `for` says which pieces it is compared with (picture: images and video frames; sound: audio windows; text: document pieces). `say` is the phrase embedded. Extend it here or with library.tags; never anything about a particular person.
